subject.title: feat(macos): redesign Share This Mac sheet with custom deck-style controls

question: Should Crabfleet adopt this custom deck-style control system as the supported design direction for the Share This Mac sheet?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the native app’s interaction presentation and visual language at substantial scope; functional preservation alone cannot settle whether this is the desired permanent product direction.

options.title: Approve the deck redesign
options.body: Merge after a maintainer completes a native visual and interaction pass covering normal, disabled, active, and overflow content states.

options.title: Request a narrower restyle
options.body: Keep the behavioral layout and adopt only the approved visual elements if the new custom control system is too large a permanent UI surface.

recommendation.title: Approve the deck redesign
recommendation.body: Merge after a maintainer completes a native visual and interaction pass covering normal, disabled, active, and overflow content states.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work place this contributor closest to the Share This Mac UI and its preserved permission-monitoring behavior.
